resources.string: Each tap opens GitSync.md and runs this action once without asking again. It stays bound to this repository, branch and saved connection/account. New local commits are allowed. Changed bindings stop the shortcut; review and create a new shortcut to approve them. You can revoke authorization here at any time.
Shortcut requested. Approve it in your launcher, then refresh shortcuts to check its state.
Not active. Launcher approval may be pending, or authorization was revoked.
This shortcut will stop running Git actions. Its launcher icon may remain disabled until you remove it. Creating a new shortcut requires approval again.
An action is already running. This shortcut was not queued. Wait, then tap it again.
Your launcher could not accept this shortcut request. Use the actions on this screen instead.
